architecture_scope: One generic manifest and aggregate verifier integrated at the three pre-side-effect runtime boundaries.
gate_state: The complete closure audit is valid; one Sol implementation must make it an executable fail-closed gate before any hydration or live retry.

first_broken_edge.cause: The retained checkout lacks 10 offline DBC/DB2 files and 3 validation-gear files, while the native DataDir has required assets but no sealed extraction-provenance receipt; existing checks expose these one at a time.

scope_lock.objective: Implement the audit-derived manifest and verifier, prove aggregate diagnostics in fixtures, and fail closed at capture, readback, and live-launch boundaries.
scope_lock.stop_condition: Stop after one committed implementation and focused deterministic validation; do not hydrate assets or consume any downstream runtime budget.

acceptance_conditions: The verifier reports the whole missing and mismatched closure in one typed result, including the current 13 retained inputs and native provenance receipt.
All three production entrypoints invoke the same gate before their first downstream side effect.
The manifest and verifier are reusable across raids and dungeons and contain no Magmaw-specific exception.
forbidden: No files outside the seven owned paths; no asset copy, DVC operation, server, DB operation, live canary, rebuild, gameplay change, Magmaw-specific exception, or first-missing-file repair.
next_action: Run the bounded Sol implementation, then authorize a separate Sol review before using the checklist as a live gate.
